above.name: Matthaeus Kosinar
above.when: b. about 1774 · witness at Franz's marriage in 1800 · d. 16 April 1819, aged 45
above.what: FRANZ'S BROTHER, and for a day the archive could not say whether he was that or Franz's father. His death settles it: aged 45 in 1819 is born about 1774, and Franz was born 1775–76. He was twenty-six when he stood witness, and he could not write his own name.
above.cite: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1780-1815 - one of the two Beystände at the marriage of Franz Kosinar and Maria Dortschen on 27 October 1800, entered "MATTHAEUS KOSINAR" and SIGNING WITH A CROSS, so he could not write. The other witness is "Simon Rauth"; both are entered "Bauern". HIS DEATH, read 22 September 2026: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1835 book p.64 - "1819, den 16ten April · Ober-Feichting · 14 · MATTHÄUS KOSINA · Keischler · katholisch · männlich · ALTER 45 · Rothlauf und Brand". DIED 16 APRIL 1819, AGED 45, so born about 1774 - WHICH ANSWERS THE OPEN QUESTION. Franz was born 1775-76. Two men born a year or two apart are not father and son, so the man who stood witness in 1800 was FRANZ'S BROTHER and was twenty-six when he did it. He is the only Matthäus Kozina in the parish death index for 1812-1835. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 33 and sig. 00894 image 33

above.name: Franz Kosinar
above.when: b. about 1775–76 · m. 27 October 1800 · d. 22 January 1849, aged 73
above.what: Martin's grandfather. A Häusler, and an Ausnehmer — a householder who has handed over — by the end. HE DIED AT OBERFEICHTING 9, THE HOUSE HE HELD HIMSELF IN 1820, on the evidence of his son Valentin's baptism; his son Johann was keeping it by 1833, and his grandson Martin was born in it in 1841. He did not move in with his son. He gave his son the house and stayed in it.
above.cite: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1780-1815, read 22 September 2026 - "Den 27ten [8ber 1800] · Feichting b. St. Joh. · 10. · FRANZ KOSINAR · katholisch · 24 · ledig" marrying "MARIA DORTSHEN · katholisch · 20 · ledig". Witnesses "MATTHAEUS KOSINAR" and "Simon Rauth", Bauern, Matthaeus signing with a cross; married by "Matthaeus Lauts, coop.", Pfarrer St. Martin. SO HE WAS BORN ABOUT 1776 and she about 1780. Named again as "Franz Kosinar, Hueblar" at his daughter GERTRAUD's baptism, 18 March 1814 at HOUSE 10 (sig. 00885 image 15), and as "Franz Kosinar, Haeusler" in the Aeltern des Braeutigams column at his son JOHANN's marriage of 6 January 1833 (sig. 00899 image 37). He is Martin Kozina's grandfather, four generations above Hedviga. His own baptism would be about 1776 and so in sig. 00883 (1747-1779), NOT looked for yet. HIS DEATH, read 22 September 2026: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869 book p.61 - "22. - 24. [Jaenner 1849] · Ob. Feichtg · 9 · FRANZ KOSINA, Ausnehmer · katholisch · maennlich · ALTER 73 · Lungenentzuendung · versehen". DIED 22 JANUARY 1849, BURIED 24 JANUARY, AGED 73 - which puts his birth at 1775-76 and CONFIRMS the age of 24 he gave at his marriage, from a second and independent record. He is an AUSNEHMER, a retired householder living on the Ausnahm, and he died at OBERFEICHTING No. 9. CORRECTED 22 September 2026: this row said he had 'retired into his son's house'. HOUSE 9 WAS HIS OWN. His son Valentin was baptised there on 15 February 1820 with Franz entered HAUBLER, the man of the house (sig. 00885 image 55), and Elisabeth was baptised at house 9 in 1812. He held 9, his son Johann was keeping it by 1833, his grandson MARTIN WAS BORN IN IT in 1841, and he died in it as an Ausnehmer in 1849. He did not move in with his son; he handed the house over and stayed in it. The family were at house 10 in 1814-15 and at 9 before and after, so the two numbers are a move and not two households. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 33 and sig. 00895 image 62

above.name: Maria "Mina" Dortschen
above.when: b. about 1781 · m. 27 October 1800, aged 20 · d. 11 April 1841, aged 60, an Auszüglerin at Oberfeichting 9
above.what: Martin's grandmother, and the mother of six children now known by name — three of whom died before they were a year old. SHE DIED IN THE HOUSE SHE HAD HANDED OVER: «Auszüglerin» is the female of the «Ausnehmer» this same register calls Franz at his own death in that house eight years later. AND HER GRANDSON MARTIN WAS BORN IN IT SEVEN MONTHS AFTER SHE DIED IN IT. Six clerks wrote her surname across thirty-three years and FOUR OF THEM WROTE «Dortschen» — 1800, 1812, 1815, 1820 — against this archive's own bracketed «Do[m]shan» of 1814 and «Tom[sh]shan» of 1833. The archive now leads with Dortschen and keeps all six.
above.cite: Poročna knjiga 1780-1815 - "MARIA DORTSHEN, katholisch, 20, ledig", marrying Franz Kosinar on 27 October 1800, SO BORN ABOUT 1780. THE SURNAME, from six clerks across thirty-three years: "Dortshen" 1800 · "Dortschen" at Elisabeth's baptism 1812 · "Do[m]shan" at Gertraud's 1814 · "Dortschen" at Maria's 1815 · "Dortschen" at Valentin's 1820 · "Tom[sh]shan" at Johann's marriage 1833. FOUR OF THE SIX READ DORTSCHEN and the archive now leads with it; the other two are this archive's own bracketed readings and are kept as read. MINA is the short form these registers use for Marija, and one clerk writes MARINA. SIX OF HER CHILDREN ARE NOW KNOWN BY NAME: Johann about 1802, Elisabeth 1812, Gertraud 1814, Maria 1815, MARIA 1818 and Valentin 1820 - and THREE OF THE SIX died before they were a year old. THE SECOND MARIA, read 22 September 2026, is named for the sister who had died in March 1816, which is ordinary practice and is why this archive counted five for part of one evening and then six. Two index entries were long unaccounted for - Kosina Dorothea p.8 (1813) and Kosina Marianna p.16 (1813). CORRECTED 27 September 2026: this row said BOTH PAGES WERE OPENED and the whole father column of each read at 2.4x, and that THERE IS NO KOSINA ON EITHER. THAT WAS WRONG FOR PAGE 16. Re-read at nine times magnification, the entry of 12 August 1813 at house 27 gives MARIANNA, father LUKAS KOSINER, Kaischler - and she is almost certainly the Marianna Kosina who died at Breg 12 in 1840 aged 26. Two and a half times was not enough for that hand. CORRECTED AGAIN THE SAME DAY, AND FOR THE SAME REASON. For an hour this row also said PAGE 8 STILL HAS NO KOSINA, on the strength of a 3.2x pass that found two Dorotheas - house 28 to Primus Wit[nitz] and house 18 to Johann Holz. THERE ARE THREE DOROTHEAS ON PAGE 8. The third is "6. [Hornung 1813] · 12 · DOROTHEA · ehelich · Vater: ANTON KOSINER RECTE KATZIN, Inwohner · Mutter: MARGARETH ZUBERTH". The whole father column has now been read at 8x and she is the only Kosiner on it. BOTH INDEX ENTRIES ARE THEREFORE ACCOUNTED FOR - and NEITHER CHILD IS HERS: Marianna is Lukas Kosina’s, and Dorothea is Anton’s. AND ANTON’S ENTRY CARRIES A WARNING FOR THIS WHOLE FILE: RECTE marks the legal surname against the name in daily use, so the family name is KATZIN and KOSINER is what they were called - most likely after the house. A Kosina in this index is not always a Kosina in the family. SHE WAS ALIVE IN FEBRUARY 1820, at about forty, because Valentin was baptised then and entered ehelich. HER DEATH IS STILL NOT FOUND, and the search is now exhaustive for this parish: the K section of the death index for 1812-1835 (sig. 04634, images 125-126) was read end to end on 22 September 2026 and holds SIX Kozina - Elisabeth 1813 p.6, TWO Maria 1816 both p.34, Matthäus 1819 p.64, Valentin 1820 p.72, Margareth 1826 p.132 - and the two 1816 Marias are a woman of 78 and a baby of nine months, NEITHER of them her. The index for 1836-1869 (sig. 04635) holds only Franz 1849 and Luzia 1850. HER DEATH, FOUND 27 SEPTEMBER 2026 by walking the 1836-1869 register itself rather than trusting its index: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869 book p.27 - "1841, April · am 11. gestorben, am 13. begraben · OBERFEICHTING [ditto] · 9 · MARIA KOSINA, AUSZUGLERIN · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 60 Jahre · Convulsionen · versehen". DIED 11 APRIL 1841, BURIED 13 APRIL, AGED 60, AT OBERFEICHTING 9. Born about 1781, which is the 20 she gave at her marriage in October 1800. AUSZUGLERIN is the female of AUSNEHMER - a householder who has handed over and lives on the Ausnahm - and it is the exact word this same register uses for FRANZ at his own death in THE SAME HOUSE eight years later (p.61, 22 January 1849, aged 73). SHE DIED IN THE HOUSE SHE HAD HANDED OVER. AND THE DATE IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS: her grandson MARTIN WAS BORN IN THAT HOUSE ON 16 NOVEMBER 1841, SEVEN MONTHS AFTER SHE DIED IN IT. THE INDEX FOR 1836-1869 DOES NOT LIST HER, and that is now the fourth positive proof that it is incomplete - it holds Franz 1849 and Luzia 1850 and nobody else, while the register itself yields Marianna 1840, MARIA 1841, Joseph 1843 and Ursula 1845/46 in the first 105 pages alone. An index proves what it contains and never what it omits. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 33, sig. 00885 images 4, 15, 23 and 55, sig. 00899 image 37

above.name: Johann Kosina
above.when: b. about 1802–03 · m. 6 January 1833 · d. 10 October 1868, aged 64, at Zgornje Bitno 9
above.what: Martin's uncle, and the householder of the house Martin was born in — a Häubler at his wedding and a Häubler at his death thirty-five years later, in the same house both times.
above.cite: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1816-1855, book p.35 - "1833, 6. Jaenner, Obern feichting 9, JOHANN KOSINAR, Haeusler, katholisch, 30 Jahre, ledig" marrying "LUZIA LABORNIK, 38, ledig". HIS PARENTS: "Franz Kosinar, Haeusler" and "Mina Tom[sh]shan, Haeuslerin". Born about 1802-03. THE BRIDE IS THE PROOF: Johann Kosina, Haeusler of Oberfeichting 9, had his first child with Lucia Labornik on 20 January 1834, a year and a fortnight later - so the house, the trade, the wife and the date all agree and the identification does not rest on the surname at all. Children ANTON 1834 and PETRUS 1836 at Oberfeichting 9 by Lucia Labornik; then, by a second wife URSULA SEDEJ, three daughters whose days are now all read: FRANZISKA baptised 19 September 1853, ANNA born and baptised 25 July 1856, MARIA born and baptised 7 August 1859 - six children over twenty-five years in one house, and he was about sixty-one at the last of them. CORRECTED 27 September 2026: this row said FRANZ 1853. The register says FRANCISCA and ticks Maedchen. And MARIA 1859 is new - the K section of the baptismal index was read end to end that day and it holds SIX Kozina, not five. HIS DEATH, found 27 September 2026 at the end of the walk that the index had made necessary: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869 book p.167 - "1868, October · 10. gestorben, 12. begraben · ZGORNJE BITNO · 9 · JOHANN KOZINA, Haubler · katholisch · maennlich · ALTER 64 Jahre · Auszehrung". DIED 10 OCTOBER 1868, BURIED 12 OCTOBER, AGED 64, AT ZGORNJE BITNO 9 - the Slovene name for Oberfeichting, and the same house. Age 64 puts his birth at about 1804 against the 30 he gave at his marriage in January 1833, which gives 1802-03: a two-year spread, which is what register ages do. He is a HAUBLER to the end, the word he carried at his wedding thirty-five years earlier. THE INDEX FOR 1836-1869 DOES NOT LIST HIM, and he is the seventh of the nine Kozina in that register that it missed. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00899 image 37, sig. 00886 images 19 and 34

above.name: Lucia Labornik
above.when: b. about 1795 · m. 6 January 1833, aged 38 · d. 30 November 1850, aged 55
above.what: Johann's wife — Martin's aunt by marriage rather than his blood, and the woman keeping the house he was born in. She died there of the same pneumonia as her father-in-law, twenty-two months after him, and that is why Johann is beside a second wife by 1853.
above.cite: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869, book p.71 - "30. - 2. Xbr [1850] · Ob. Feichtg · 9 · LUZIA KOSINA, Hueblersweib · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 55 · Lungenentzuendung · versehen · Jos. Kartely". DIED 30 NOVEMBER 1850, BURIED 2 DECEMBER, AGED 55, so born about 1795 - and she was 38 at her marriage in January 1833, which gives 1794-95. THE SAME WOMAN. She is entered a Hueblers-WEIB and not a widow, which is right: Johann outlived her. AND IT EXPLAINS THE SECOND WIFE - Johann is beside Ursula Sedej by 1853 because Lucia died in 1850. Married 6 January 1833 aged 38 to Johann Kosina, Haeusler of Oberfeichting 9 (Porocna knjiga 1816-1855 p.35); her parents "Ma[thes] Labornik, Haeusler" and "Gertraud Mag[nishan]"; mother of Anton 1834 and Petrus 1836. SAME HOUSE AND SAME DISEASE AS FRANZ, twenty-two months apart. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00899 image 37 and sig. 00895 image 72

above.name: Gertraud "Gertruda" Kosina
above.when: baptised 18 March 1814 · d. 5 March 1880, aged 65, unmarried, at Zgornje Bitno 9
above.what: MARTIN'S MOTHER — the «Gertruda» the tree knows only as a name, and now the only person on this page with a birth and a death both read at the page. Twenty-seven when she bore him, unmarried then and unmarried at the end, and she died in the house she bore him in, thirteen days short of sixty-six.
above.cite: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831, book p.28 - "den 18. Merz, Haus 10, Gertrud, ehelich, Vater: FRANZ KOSINAR, Hueblar, Mutter: MARIA DO[M]SHAN". She was 27 when she bore Martin. HER BROTHER IS JOHANN: his marriage of 6 January 1833 gives his father as "Franz Kosinar, Haeusler" and his mother as "Mina Tom[sh]shan, Haeuslerin" - the same couple. RETRACTION: on 21 September 2026 this entry was ELIMINATED here on the grounds that the surname "ends in a clear -r, so it is KOSNAR not Kosina". That was wrong. The -r is how THIS clerk writes the family name, and he writes it identically for Johann, whose own children are entered KOSINA by the next clerk. One family, two hands. HER DEATH, read 22 September 2026: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1870-1890, book p.69 - "5. - 7. [Marec 1880] · Zg. Bitno · 9 · JERA KOZINA, neomozena gostja · katolik · zenski · ALTER 65 let · bozjast in jetika · M. Zarnik". DIED 5 MARCH 1880, BURIED 7 MARCH, AGED 65, UNMARRIED, AT ZGORNJE BITNO 9 - THE HOUSE SHE BORE MARTIN IN. JERA is the Slovene short form of GERTRUDA. Baptised 18 March 1814, she died THIRTEEN DAYS SHORT OF HER SIXTY-SIXTH BIRTHDAY, so the clerk's 65 is exact. NEOMOZENA - never married, which is what the unehelich on Martin's baptism already said. GOSTJA - a lodger, the word for a woman living in a house that is not hers, in the house her brother Johann held. The cause is "bozjast in jetika": the falling sickness and consumption. RETRACTION, THE SAME DAY: this row said for two hours that SHE LEFT THE PARISH, on the grounds that her son's Senj marriage of January 1888 carries no dagger against her name. She had been dead eight years. An absent mark is not a record. Found by reading the 1870-1890 register opening by opening after the 1890-1911 one had given nothing. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 15, sig. 00899 image 37, sig. 03916 image 72, sig. 03917 read in full

household.name: Maria Kosinar the elder
household.what: The oldest of the name the archive has reached — a generation above Franz and Matthäus. A CANDIDATE for their mother and nothing more: another village, no husband named, and this book names no parents.
household.cite: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1835 book p.34 - "Den 27 [Februar 1816] · Z[ubern] · 4 · MARIA KOZINAR · Häubl · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 78 Jahre · Altersschwäche". SEVENTY-EIGHT, of old age, which puts her birth at about 1738 and makes her the oldest person of this name the archive has reached - a generation above Franz and Matthäus, who were born about 1775 and 1774. She is therefore a CANDIDATE FOR THEIR MOTHER and nothing more: the village is not Feichting, no husband is named, and this book names no parents. THE VILLAGE IS NOT SECURELY READ. It is written the same way twice on this page, house 4 both times, and at 9x it reads "Zubern" or "Luberan"; it is recorded as the clerk wrote it rather than resolved into a modern name. She is the SECOND of the two «Kozina Maria - 34» the index lists for 1816; the other is Franz's nine-month-old daughter. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00894 image 18, sig. 04634 image 126

household.name: Elisabeth Kosinar
household.when: baptised 18 November 1812 · died 11 April 1813, aged five months
household.cite: BAPTISM: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.6 - "18. [November 1812] · Haus 9 · ELISABETH · katholisch · weiblich · ehelich · Vater: FRANZ KOSINER · Mutter: MINA DORTSCHEN · Paten Jakob Dollenz and Elisabeth, signing with a cross · den 18ten um 3 Uhr früh". DEATH: Mrliška knjiga 1812-1835 book p.6 - "11. [April 1813] · Ober-Feichting W. Ursula · 9 · ELIZABETHA KOSINA · Tochter · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 5 Monath · Fraiß". FIVE MONTHS OLD, of convulsions. She is the first of the three children of this marriage the archive has found who did not live. Indexed as "Kosina Elisabeth 6" in BOTH the baptismal index 1812-1831 and the death index 1812-1835. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 4, sig. 00894 image 4, sig. 04631 image 169, sig. 04634 image 125

household.name: Maria Kosinar
household.when: baptised 8 August 1815 · died 31 March 1816, aged three quarters of a year
household.what: Franz and Maria's daughter, and THE «Kozina Maria» the death index sends a reader to page 34 to find. Convulsions.
household.cite: BAPTISM: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.44 - "den 8ten [August 1815] · Haus 10 · MARIA · katholisch · weiblich · ehelich · Vater: FRANZ KOSINAR, Häubler · Mutter: MARIA DORTSCHEN · um 10 Uhr Nachmittag". DEATH: Mrliška knjiga 1812-1835 book p.34 - "den 31 [März 1816] · Oberfeichting · 9 · MARIA KOZINAR · Häubl[erskind] · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 3/4 Jahr · Fraiß". Born 8 August 1815 and dead on 31 March 1816 is seven and a half months, which is what three quarters of a year means in this column. SHE IS ONE OF THE TWO «Kozina Maria - 34» the death index lists for 1816, and she is the one a reader would be looking for. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 23, sig. 00894 image 18, sig. 04631 image 169, sig. 04634 image 126

household.name: Valentin Kosina
household.when: baptised 15 February 1820 · died 29 February 1820, aged one week
household.what: Franz and Maria's son, fourteen days old. HIS BAPTISM IS THE PROOF OF THE HOUSE: it is the record that puts Franz at Oberfeichting 9 as a Häubler, twenty-one years before Martin was born there.
household.cite: BAPTISM: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.108 - "Den 15ten Hornung [February] 1820 · Ober-Feichting · 9 · VALENTIN · katholisch · männlich · ehelich · Vater: FRANZ KOSINA, HÄUBLER · Mutter: MARINA DORTSCHEN". DEATH: Mrliška knjiga 1812-1835 book p.72 - "Den 29ten Hornung · Ober-Feichting · 9 · VALENTIN KOSINA · Häubler · katholisch · männlich · ALTER 1 Woche · Fraiß". Fourteen days. THIS ENTRY IS THE PROOF OF THE HOUSE: it is the only record that names Franz, names Oberfeichting 9 and names him HÄUBLER there, twenty-one years before his grandson Martin was born in that house and twenty-nine before he died in it himself. AND IT DATES THE MOTHER: Maria Dortschen was bearing children in February 1820, so she was alive at about forty. 1820 was a leap year, so the 29th of February is a real date. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 55, sig. 00894 image 37, sig. 04631 image 169, sig. 04634 image 125

household.name: Maria Kosinar the second
household.when: baptised 6 December 1818 · d. 6 January 1868, aged 49, unmarried, at Zgornje Bitno 9
household.what: Franz and Maria's sixth known child, named for the sister who had died twenty months before she was born. She turned 49 one month before she died, so the register's age is exact. LIKE GERTRAUD SHE NEVER MARRIED AND NEVER LEFT: both sisters are entered as lodgers in the house they were born in, twelve years apart.
household.cite: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.84 - "6ten Dezember [1818] · Ober-Feichting · [10 struck, 12 written] · MARIA · katholisch · weiblich · ehelich · Vater: FRANZ KOSINAR, Häusler · Mutter: MARIA DORTSCHAN, Häuslerin". THE REGISTER CALLS HER SIMPLY MARIA; this archive says "the second" because her sister of the same name had died on 31 March 1816, twenty months before she was born. Re-using a dead child's name is ordinary practice and is not a clerical error. HER HOUSE NUMBER IS CORRECTED ON THE PAGE, 10 struck and 12 written or the reverse - which is the third time these two numbers have moved under this family. Found by reading the K section of the baptismal index 1812-1831 (sig. 04631 image 169), which lists her as "Kosina Maria - 84". HER DEATH, found 27 September 2026: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869 book p.163 - "1868 · 6. gestorben, 8. begraben · ZGORNJE BITNO · 9 · MARIA KOSINA, LEDIGE INWOHNERIN · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 49 Jahre · Auszehrung · Leopold Plinar, coop.". DIED 6 JANUARY 1868, AGED 49 - and she was baptised 6 DECEMBER 1818, so she had turned 49 exactly one month before she died. THE AGE IS EXACT. LEDIGE: she never married, and she was an INWOHNERIN, a lodger, in the house she was born in. HER SISTER GERTRAUD DIED IN THE SAME HOUSE TWELVE YEARS LATER, also unmarried, also entered as a lodger - «neomozena gostja». TWO SISTERS WHO NEVER LEFT AND NEVER MARRIED, in a house neither of them owned. The index lists neither. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 43, sig. 04631 image 169

household.name: Ursula Kosina
household.when: d. 28 March 1845, aged 85, of Altersschwäche · Oberfeichting 13
household.what: The second-oldest of the name this archive has reached, and at a THIRD Oberfeichting house — neither Franz's 9 nor Matthäus's 14. And she is entered ABNEHMERIN: she had HELD that house and handed it over, the same institution this register calls Franz an Ausnehmer for and Maria Dortschen an Auszüglerin. The third Kosina house in the village was hers. Still only a candidate for the generation above Franz — no parents, no husband, no children are named.
household.cite: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1836-1869 book p.43 - "1845, März · 28. gestorben, 30. begraben · Ob. Feichting · 13 · URSCHULA KOSINA, ABNEHMERIN · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 85 · Altersschwäche · versehen · idem". EIGHTY-FIVE, of old age, so BORN ABOUT 1760 - a generation above Franz (1775-76) and Matthäus (about 1774), and the second-oldest of the name this archive has reached after the Maria who died at 78 in 1816. AT OBERFEICHTING 13, which is neither Franz’s 9 nor Matthäus’s 14: a THIRD house of the name in one village. THE DATE, COMPLETED 27 September 2026: this row read "28th of a month in 1845 or 1846" for a day, because the month heading sits above the entry and had not been transcribed. The page was re-opened and read from its own head down. The printed year at the top of the column is 1845; the month headings run Jänner (29th), Februar (26th), MäRZ (2nd) - and from there the days run 2, 4, 6, 12, 13, 16, 18, 18, 25, 28, 30 without another heading, the last of them buried "1. April". HERS IS THE 28th, INSIDE MARCH. She died 28 MARCH 1845 and was buried on the 30th. AND THE WORD UNDER HER NAME IS NEW AND IT MATTERS: ABNEHMERIN, read at 10x. It is the female of Abnehmer and it is the same institution as the AUSNEHMER this register calls Franz at his death in 1849 and the AUSZÜGLERIN it calls Maria Dortschen at hers in 1841 - a householder who has HANDED THE HOUSE OVER and lives on the reserved portion. SO SHE HELD OBERFEICHTING 13 AND GAVE IT UP. She is not a lodger and not somebody’s widowed mother taken in: the third Kosina house in this village was HERS. That makes her a stronger candidate for the generation above Franz than the bare age did, and it still does not prove it - no parents, no husband, no children are named here. THE INDEX DOES NOT LIST HER. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00895 image 44

household.name: Franziska Kozina
household.when: baptised 19 September 1853 · d. 7 March 1864, aged 11, of measles · Oberfeichting 9
household.what: Johann and Ursula's daughter, and a correction now made: this archive recorded their child of 1853 as a FRANZ. The register writes FRANCISCA and TICKS MÄDCHEN. One child, not two, and the death register had her right for eleven years before the baptismal one was asked.
household.cite: BAPTISM, read 27 September 2026 on this row’s own instruction: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1832-1870 book p.130 - "September 19. · Obr. Feichting · 9 · FRANCISCA · katholisch · ehelich · Vater: JOHANN KOZINA, Hüblar · Mutter: URSULA SEDEJ · Paten Johann Pevc and Marina Dolenc". THE SEX COLUMN, WHICH IS WHAT THIS ROW WAS OPENED FOR: the stroke stands in MÄDCHEN and the Knaben cell holds a dot. Read at 8x, and then checked a second way - the tick column was cropped from the printed heading down to her line and counted against all sixteen entries of the page, so the mark is placed by the column it sits under and not by eye. SHE IS A GIRL. DEATH: Mrliška knjiga 1836-1869 book p.140 - "1864, März · 7. gestorben, 9. begraben · OBERNFEICHTING · 9 · FRANZISKA KOZINA, Hüblersdochter · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 11 Jahre · MASERN · A. Graf". Baptised 19 September 1853 and dead on 7 March 1864 is ten years and five months; the clerk’s 11 rounds up by seven, which is the ordinary slack of that column. THE CORRECTION: this archive recorded Johann’s child of 1853 as FRANZ, a son, and then asked whether the girl dying of measles in that house was a second child or the same one misread. She is the same one. There is no Franz. The index (sig. 04632, entry 213) writes the given name short and it can be read either way; the register writes FRANCISCA in full and ticks Mädchen. The death register had her right for eleven years before the baptismal register was asked. Her parents are named here for the first time - the death book named none. BORN AND BAPTISED THE SAME DAY, 7 AUGUST 1859, at Oberfeichting 9 - Johann’s house, the house his father held before him and his nephew Martin was born in. She is Johann’s sixth known child and the third by Ursula Sedej, after Franziska 1853 and Ana 1856. HOW SHE WAS FOUND: not by looking for her. On 27 September 2026 the K section of the baptismal index for 1832-1870 was read end to end to settle a count, and she is entry 262 - "Maria Kozina - 159" - a name the archive had never carried. The count of FIVE Kozina baptisms in that volume was short by her. HER FATHER WAS SIXTY-ONE when she was born on this book’s own arithmetic - he died in 1868 aged 64 - so she was nine when she lost him, and her sister Franziska had died of measles in that house when she was four. WHAT IS NOT KNOWN is what became of her: she is not in the 1836-1869 death register, which this archive walked in full, so she was alive in 1870. household.name: Joseph Kosina
household.when: d. 27 March 1843, aged two, of Halsentzündung · Oberfeichting 9
household.what: A Häubler's son at the house Johann held and Martin was born in, so almost certainly Johann and Lucia's, and a brother of Anton 1834 and Petrus 1836. This book names no parents — AND THE BAPTISMAL INDEX HAS NO JOSEPH. Its whole K section was read end to end on 27 September 2026 and the six Kozina it holds do not include him, so he was baptised outside the parish or that index missed him, as the death index for these years missed nine.
household.cite: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1836-1869 book p.33 - "1843, März · 27. gestorben · OBERFEICHTING · 9 · JOSEPH KOSINA, Häublers Sohn · katholisch · männlich · ALTER 2 Jahre · Halsentzündung". Born about 1841, DIED AT TWO, AT OBERFEICHTING 9 - the house Johann Kosina held as Häusler from 1833, where Martin was born in November 1841 and where Franz died in 1849. A HÄUBLER'S SON at that house in 1843 is Johann's son, and so a brother of ANTON 1834 and PETRUS 1836. NOT PROVED: this book names no parents. THE COUNT IS NOW SETTLED AND IT DOES NOT HELP HIM. On 27 September 2026 the whole K section of the 1832-1870 baptismal index (sig. 04632, images 246 and 247, entry 1 to entry 369, 1832 to 1870) was read end to end. It holds SIX Kozina and no more: Anton 1834 p.18 - Petrus 1836 p.33 - Martin 1841 p.64 - Francisca 1853 p.130 - Ana 1856 p.144 - MARIA 1859 p.159. The old count of five was short by one, and the one it had missed is MARIA 1859, not Joseph. THERE IS NO JOSEPH IN THAT INDEX. So either he was baptised outside the parish, or this index missed him the way the death index for the same years missed nine Kozina. The second is the likelier of the two on this archive’s own evidence, and neither is proved. Found by walking the register on 27 September 2026; THE INDEX DOES NOT LIST HIM. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00895 image 34

household.name: Marianna Kosina
household.when: baptised 12 August 1813 · d. 10 January 1840, aged 26, unmarried, of Abzehrung · Breg 12
household.what: LUKAS KOSINA'S DAUGHTER, and so a sister of the 1818 Gertraud this archive had to rule out before Martin's mother could be settled. Her baptism gives «Vater: LUKAS KOSINER, Kaischler» — and she dies a Keuschlerstochter at twenty-six, which is the same word and the right age to the month. Born the same year as the other Gertraud and at a village that is not Feichting.
household.how: daughter of Lukas — not of Franz's line
household.cite: DEATH: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1836-1869 book p.22 - "1840, Jänner · am 10. gestorben, am 12. begraben · BREG · 12 · MARIANNA KOSINA, Keuschlerstochter · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 26 Jahre · Abzehrung · versehen". BAPTISM, FOUND 27 September 2026: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.16 - "12. [August 1813] · Haus 27 · MARIANNA · katholisch · weiblich · ehelich · Vater: LUKAS KOSINER, Kaischler · Mutter: LUZIA O[K]LIN[T]SH". THE MATCH IS THREE THINGS AT ONCE. The age: baptised 12 August 1813, she was 26 years and five months on 10 January 1840, and the clerk wrote 26. The trade: she dies a KEUSCHLERSTOCHTER and her father is entered a KAISCHLER, which is the same word. And the index: the 1812-1831 baptismal index lists "Kosina Marianna - 16" under 1813, and this entry is on book page 16. NOT PROVED - the 1813 entry gives a house number and no village, so it cannot be tied to Breg, and no register yet read joins the two records directly. But it is no longer a guess. SHE IS LUKAS KOSINA’S DAUGHTER, and so a sister of the GERTRAUD he had in 1818 - the Gertraud this archive had to rule out before it could say Martin’s mother was the Gertraud of 1814. THE CORRECTION THIS COST: this archive published that page 16 had been opened and its whole father column read at 2.4x, and that THERE IS NO KOSINA ON IT. There is. Two and a half times magnification was not enough for this hand; at nine times the name is plain. Breg is a fourth Kosina settlement in the parish after Franz’s Oberfeichting 9, Matthäus’s 14 and Ursula’s 13, and she is still born the same year as Gertraud Kozina of Feichting, who lived to 1880 - a reminder that a name and a year together prove nothing. THE 1836-1869 DEATH INDEX DOES NOT LIST HER. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00895 image 23, sig. 00885 image 9, sig. 04631 image 169

household.name: Margaretha Kosinar
household.when: d. 14 March 1826, aged 45, a Häubler's daughter, unmarried
household.what: She died in Franz's house at forty-five, of his own generation. Most likely his sister; nothing in the entry proves it.
household.cite: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1835 book p.130 - "14. März [1826] · Ober-Feichting · 9 · MARGARETHA KOZINAR · Häublers-Tochter · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 45". BORN ABOUT 1781, and she died UNMARRIED - a Häubler's daughter at forty-five - IN THE HOUSE FRANZ KOSINAR KEPT. Franz was born 1775-76 and Matthäus about 1774, so a woman born about 1781 is of their generation and not of their children's: most likely FRANZ'S SISTER, living on in her brother's house. NOTHING HERE PROVES IT and no parents are named. The death index carries her as "Kozina Margareth - 132", one opening further on than the page she is actually written on, which is the only place this index has been caught out. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00894 image 66, sig. 04634 image 125
